nodes.question: How do precipitation extremes at Ny- lesund compare to those at Svalbard Lufthavn?
nodes.answer: Ny- lesund exhibits stronger precipitation extremes compared to Svalbard Lufthavn, which is characterized by smaller values for extremes.
nodes.paragraph: In interpreting the results using the generalized extreme value theory (GEVT), the shape parameter of the distribution is an indication of the distinct regimes. It suffices to state here that if the shape parameter <0, we can expect precipitation extremes with low probability with an upper bound, while the shape parameter >0 indicates a high probability of getting precipitation extremes. For the shape parameter =0, the chances of occurrence of extremes decrease exponentially. For more details, refer to Sect. I in Supplementary information. Results Pattern of precipitation extremes in the three locations of Svalbard lesund, and Svalbard Lufthavn. We consider 99th percentile of the daily precipitation values as a threshold for the extreme events. Precipitation events above the threshold (horizontal black dashed lines) are considered as precipitation extremes. Ny- lesund exhibits strong extremes than the other two locations; Svalbard Lufthavn was characterized by smaller values for extremes. three stations. Fig. 1 .
